attributes.title: Session Lifecycle Logs
attributes.description: All logs related to charging session lifecycle events (start, active, complete, failed)

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query":{"query_string":{"query":"application:\"session-management-service\" AND (message:*session*started* OR message:*session*completed* OR message:*session*failed* OR message:*Creating*charging*session* OR message:*Successfully*updated*session*)","analyze_wildcard":true}},"filter":[],"index":"chargeroute-logs-*"}
